presidio_scan_entities: scan dataset rows for PII entities using Presidio and return masked results
analyze: analyze text batches for PII entities using a Presidio BatchAnalyzerEngine with caching
mask: mask sensitive text by replacing characters with asterisks while preserving the first two characters
get_columns_with_strings: get a list of column names that contain string data from dataset features
